{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of `severity` across `sex`
print("Severity distribution by sex:")
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_string())

# Check the distribution of `arm` across `sex`
print("\nArm distribution by sex:")
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['arm'].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_string())

# Check the distribution of `severity` across `arm`
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_string())"}
